title: Quản lý đa dạng sinh học

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the importance and value of biodiversity, threats to biodiversity, and conservation strategies.
Understand management models and tools for sustainable use of biodiversity resources.
Apply knowledge to solve practical issues related to biodiversity management at national and local levels.
Develop skills in research, analysis, and discussion on biodiversity management.
Work independently and in teams to address practical management issues.
Analyze and evaluate biodiversity management policies and practices.
Effectively communicate findings and recommendations in written and oral formats.
Manage and present group projects on biodiversity conservation and management.
Understand legal frameworks related to biodiversity conservation and management.
Apply economic tools for sustainable biodiversity management.
Understand and apply community-based management approaches for biodiversity conservation.
Integrate biodiversity conservation with sustainable development policies.
Develop and evaluate environmental plans for biodiversity conservation.
Conduct monitoring and evaluation of biodiversity conservation efforts.

prerequisite_courses: Cơ sở khoa học môi trường
Quản lý Tài nguyên và Môi trường
